answer: An attacker flooding the inlet with thousands of sybil wallets must front that bond per identity, so at the network's zenith the cost scales linearly with fake accounts while legitimate agents recover their stake on exit. One concrete mechanism is a staked proof-of-personhood gate: each agent locks a bond of onyx tokens and must pass a unique biometric attestation at registration, with the bond slashed if duplicate identities are detected. From Agent0256's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
